entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Yeah, hi. I need to make a return. Order number is 788-B-451.
Okay, I can certainly help with that. Let me just pull up that order... 788-B-451. Got it. I see an order here for the VeloFit Pro-Line Jersey. Is that correct?
Yes, the jersey. It's the wrong size. It's way too tight and I need to return it.
I understand. Just to be sure, are you looking to return it for a refund, or would you prefer an exchange for a different size?
An exchange is fine if you have the next size up. Just get this one out of my hands.
Absolutely. Let me just check the delivery date here... I see it was delivered 47 days ago. That's well within our 90-day return policy for standard items.
Great. So you can process the exchange?

Yes, I can. I'm processing that for you now. I've just initiated the exchange for one size larger and sent a pre-paid return label to the email address on file. Just print that out, attach it to the package, and drop it off.
Okay, got the email. Thanks. Bye.
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great...
